load_lvis_json: load an LVIS JSON annotation file and return a list of Detectron2 format dataset dicts
register_lvis_instances: register an LVIS dataset with the Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog for instance detection
get_lvis_instances_meta: get LVIS metadata including thing classes for a given dataset name like lvis_v0.5 or lvis_v1
run_lvis_data_vis: run the LVIS dataset loader as a CLI module to visualize annotations on sample images
review_load_lvis_json: review the load_lvis_json function to understand how LVIS annotations are parsed into Detectron2 format
